description: This file defines the class 'redminerestInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface'. The class provides methods for interacting with a Redmine issue tracking system via REST API, including connecting to the system, retrieving issues, creating issues, adding notes, and configuration templates. It manages issues' statuses, attributes, and custom fields, and contains logic for handling different Redmine versions and configurations.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class for integrating with Redmine issue tracker via REST API, supporting issue retrieval, creation, and notes addition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the redminerestInterface, sets default statuses, and establishes connection to Redmine.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and sets default configuration attributes for the Redmine API connection and issue attributes.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance used for communicating with Redmine.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a given issue ID has a valid syntax (numeric).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Redmine server and verifies accessibility.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Redmine is active.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific issue from Redmine.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status string for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Fetches the HTML string summary of a specific issue.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue with the specified ID exists on Redmine.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine with given summary, description, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note or comment to an existing Redmine issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template XML configuration for setting up the Redmine integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates if issues can be created via API based on configuration properties.
